cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth — holds her keepsake at chest height; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a sunlit white marble temple — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a wooden river dock above calm water — standing; a mirrored dance — holds a water bottle at chest height; an ancestral shrine hall with a bronze incense burner — standing; overgrown jungle temple ruins — kneeling on the ground; a misty enchanted garden of moss — standing; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — raises a small red paper lantern beside her face so its glow lights her cheek; a starship data archive — holds a cup in both hands; a red carpet and award hall with camera flashes — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds a book closed against her chest; a hot-spring town footbath under a wooden roof — standing
